# ignifx.mesh

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:schemas`. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Mesh file (`ignifx/mesh-file`)

One primitive mesh and the options its MeshAsset factory takes, so a scene file can name it by address. glTF meshes load as models instead.

| Field | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `str` | `"ignifx.mesh"` | Always "ignifx.mesh". |
| `formatVersion` | `u32` | `1` | The file format version; 1 before ignifx 1.0. |
| `name` | `str` | `""` | A name for diagnostics; empty uses the file's address. |
| `primitive` | `enum` | `"box"` | The shape: box, sphere, plane, ground, cylinder, capsule, torus. Required; an unknown value is rejected with IGX-0507. |
| `options` | `record` | `{}` | The factory's options; omitted ones take its defaults. Lengths are metres, zero or more; counts are whole numbers, one or more; uvScale is two numbers. An unknown option or a bad value is IGX-0507. By primitive: box: size, width, height, depth; sphere: diameter, segments; plane: size, width, height; ground: width, height, subdivisions, uvScale; cylinder: height, diameter, diameterTop, diameterBottom, tessellation; capsule: height, radius, tessellation; torus: diameter, thickness, tessellation. |
